About Me

Reporter & Editor

I am a recent graduate of Syracuse University's S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications and Maxwell School of Citizenship and Public Affairs, where I studied Magazine, News & Digital Journalism and Political Science as an 1870 Scholar.

I am an incoming Dow Jones Multiplatform Editing intern at Chalkbeat and Votebeat. I recently served as Enterprise Editor at The Daily Orange and an investigative reporter for the Newhouse Spotlight Team and currently serve as an assistant researcher at Syracuse University's Institute for Democracy, Journalism and Citizenship, where I map local news ecosystems across New York State and study coverage gaps that reshape how communities access information. I previously worked as a part-time reporter and intern at the New York Post, where I authored 110+ stories generating over 5 million page views — often monitoring breaking political developments, reviewing court filings and reporting stories firsthand across the five boroughs.

I have published nearly 200 stories across the New York Post, The Daily Orange, City & State NY, Central Current, The Post-Standard, Unlocking New York and more. My curiosity drives my reporting across a wide range of beats — from politics and government accountability to crime, technology and features — with a particular focus on holding power to account and giving voice to those who are too often ignored.

Writing has always come easily to me, but reporting taught me to be brave. I have wanted to be a journalist for as long as I can remember — it led me from my high school paper to Newhouse and The Daily Orange, to the floor of the 2024 DNC in Chicago and to chasing stories across New York City for the New York Post. I am passionate about the intersection of media and politics and about telling stories that connect national issues to the real people living through them. The stories I am most proud of have always been the ones I was most scared to write.

I am a recipient of the Maria Riccardi Scholarship, awarded to an outstanding female undergraduate journalist at Newhouse, the Samuel V. Kennedy III Award, recognizing a graduating senior with the best potential in newspaper editing and newsroom leadership, and Syracuse University's 1870 Scholar merit award. My work was nominated for the Associated Collegiate Press 2024 Story of the Year.

I am based in the New York City metropolitan area and always open to pitches, tips and collaborations — olandersamantha@gmail.com.
